examples.en: You are barking up the wrong tree.
The manager barked up the wrong tree by blaming the new worker.

meaning.en: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.
meaning.zh: 因為判斷錯誤，把責任、懷疑、注意力或努力放在錯誤的人、原因、地方或解決方法上；即找錯方向、怪錯人、找錯對象或誤判問題所在。
naturalZh: 因為判斷錯誤，把責任、懷疑、注意力或努力放在錯誤的人、原因、地方或解決方法上
即找錯方向、怪錯人、找錯對象或誤判問題所在。

register.summaryEn: The expression is informal to neutral. It is common in conversation, workplace discussions, interviews, journalism and general writing. It may sound direct or critical, especially when used with you.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於非正式至中性語域，常見於日常對話、工作討論、訪問、新聞及一般文章。 以 you 作主語時，它可能帶有直接批評的語氣。
contextsEn: I think you may be barking up the wrong tree
I’m afraid you’re barking up the wrong tree
Could we be barking up the wrong tree?
contextsZh: 我認為你可能找錯方向了。
register.formalEn: In highly formal legal, academic or official writing, expressions such as mistaken, focusing on the wrong cause or pursuing the wrong course may be more suitable. Collins labels the idiom as informal and describes it as directing attention or effort towards the wrong person or thing.
register.formalZh: 在非常正式的法律、學術或官方文章中，使用 mistaken、focusing on the wrong cause 或 pursuing the wrong course 可能更合適。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

benefits.titleEn: It Identifies the Type of Mistake Clearly
benefits.en: The idiom does not merely say that someone is wrong. It shows that the person has directed attention, blame or effort towards the wrong target.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語不只是說某人錯了，而是指出對方把注意力、責任或努力放在錯誤的對象上。

benefits.en: Instead of giving a long explanation that someone has accused the wrong person, the idiom communicates the idea in one memorable expression.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以用簡短而容易記憶的方式，指出對方怪錯了人。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful When Rejecting a Request
benefits.titleZh: 適合用來表示對方找錯人
benefits.en: If somebody asks you to do something outside your responsibility, you can explain that they have approached the wrong person.
benefits.zh: 如果別人要求你處理不屬於你職責的事情，你可以用這個表達指出對方找錯人。 恐怕你找錯對象了。 退款由會計組處理。

examples.en: I’m afraid you’re barking up the wrong tree. The accounts team handles refunds.
examples.zh: 恐怕你找錯對象了。退款由會計組處理。

benefits.en: With may, might or could, the expression allows speakers to question an approach without claiming complete certainty.
benefits.zh: 配合 may、might 或 could，說話者可以婉轉地質疑目前的方向，而不必斷言對方一定錯誤。 我們可能找錯方向了。

examples.en: We might be barking up the wrong tree.

benefits.titleEn: It Is Natural in Problem-Solving Discussions
benefits.titleZh: 適合用於解決問題的討論
benefits.en: The idiom is useful when a team is considering whether it has identified the correct cause, person or solution.
benefits.zh: 當團隊正在判斷是否找對原因、人物或解決方法時，這個表達十分實用。

benefits.titleEn: It Provides a Vivid but Compact Alternative
benefits.titleZh: 提供生動而簡潔的替代說法
benefits.en: The idiom is useful, but it is not automatically better than plain language. Use it only when there is a clear mistaken target or direction.
benefits.zh: 我們一直追查錯方向。 這個慣用語十分實用，但並非在所有情況下都比一般說法更好。 只有在確實存在錯誤對象或錯誤方向時，才應使用。

examples.en: We have been barking up the wrong tree.

origin.statusEn: Most Likely Origin; Exact First Use Uncertain
origin.statusZh: 最可能的來源；確切首次用法不明

history.en: The exact first use has not been identified. An example in James Kirke Paulding’s 1832 novel Westward Ho! is often cited, while a historical glossary also records American examples from 1833. These are early written records, not proof that either writer invented the expression.
history.zh: 這個表達的確切首次用法尚未能確認。 James Kirke Paulding 在1832年的小說《Westward Ho! 》 中的例子經常被引用，而一部歷史詞彙資料亦收錄了1833年的美國用例。 這些只是較早期的文字記錄，並不能證明任何一位作者創造了這個表達。

history.en: The image of a dog choosing the wrong tree naturally developed into the idea of a person pursuing the wrong suspect, explanation, place or solution.
history.zh: 狗選錯樹的畫面，逐漸引申為某人追查錯誤的嫌疑人、解釋、地方或解決方法。

origin.memoryEn: The dog chooses the wrong tree; the person chooses the wrong target.
origin.memoryZh: 狗找錯了樹；人找錯了對象。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：保留完整固定形式
rules.en: Correct target: bark up the wrong tree. Incorrect target forms: bark at the wrong tree; bark up a wrong tree; bark up wrong tree.

rules.titleEn: Use It for Misdirected Thinking or Effort
rules.titleZh: 規則二：用於錯誤的思考或努力方向
rules.en: blames the wrong person; suspects the wrong person; looks in the wrong place; focuses on the wrong cause; asks the wrong person for help; tries the wrong solution.
rules.zh: 當某人怪錯人、懷疑錯對象、找錯地方、誤判原因、向錯的人求助或使用錯誤方法時，便可以使用這個表達。

rules.titleEn: It Does Not Mean Every Kind of Mistake
rules.titleZh: 規則三：不是所有錯誤都可以使用
rules.en: Writing one incorrect date is simply a mistake. It does not necessarily involve following a wrong person, cause or line of enquiry.
rules.zh: 我寫錯日期，所以我找錯方向。 寫錯一個日期只是一般錯誤，未必涉及追查錯誤的人、原因或方向。

examples.en: I wrote the wrong date, so I barked up the wrong tree.
examples.zh: 我寫錯日期，所以我找錯方向。

rules.titleEn: The Subject Must Be Following the Wrong Direction
rules.titleZh: 規則四：主語必須是判斷或方向錯誤的一方
rules.en: The police were following the mistaken line of enquiry.
rules.zh: 警方盤問亞倫是追查錯方向。 警方是作出錯誤追查的一方。

examples.en: The police were barking up the wrong tree by questioning Aaron.
examples.zh: 警方盤問亞倫是追查錯方向。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：保留時態及確定程度
rules.en: Do not change may be barking into were barking. This would turn a possibility into an established past fact.
rules.zh: 我們可能找錯方向了。 我們當時找錯方向了。 不要把 may be barking 改成 were barking，否則會把可能性變成已確定的過去事實。

examples.en: We may be barking up the wrong tree.
We were barking up the wrong tree.

rules.titleZh: 規則六：有需要時減輕批評語氣
rules.en: I’m afraid you may be barking up the wrong tree.
rules.zh: 直接說 You’re barking up the wrong tree 可能令人感到被批評。 面對顧客、同事或不熟悉的人時，可以加入 I think、may、might 或 I’m afraid。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：避免意外產生字面意思
rules.en: The dog was barking at the tree. Every answer in this exercise must use the figurative meaning.
rules.zh: 狗正向着樹吠叫。 偵探盤問一名無辜的人，是追查錯方向。 本練習中的所有答案都必須使用比喻意思。

examples.en: The detective was barking up the wrong tree by questioning an innocent person.
examples.zh: 偵探盤問一名無辜的人，是追查錯方向。

rules.titleZh: 規則八：只使用指定目標表達

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using bark up the wrong tree. Change bark according to the required subject, tense or modal verb, but keep up the wrong tree fixed.
instructions.zh: 使用 bark up the wrong tree 改寫句子或完成回應。 按照主語、時態或情態動詞改變 bark，但必須保留固定部分 up the wrong tree。

questions.prompt: Nora thinks Ethan took her notebook, but Ethan was absent that day.
questions.promptZh: 諾拉認為是伊森拿走她的筆記簿，但伊森那天缺席。
questions.answer: Nora is barking up the wrong tree by blaming Ethan for taking her notebook, as he was absent that day.
questions.answerZh: 諾拉怪錯了伊森，因為伊森那天缺席，不可能拿走她的筆記簿。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The teacher blames the printer for the missing page, but the student never saved the page.
questions.promptZh: 老師認為缺少的一頁是打印機造成的，但學生根本沒有儲存那一頁。
questions.answer: The teacher is barking up the wrong tree by blaming the printer for the missing page; the student never saved it.
questions.answerZh: 老師怪錯了打印機；學生根本沒有儲存那一頁。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.answer: You are barking up the wrong tree by asking Leo to change the booking because only the hotel can do it.
questions.answerZh: 你請里奧更改預訂是找錯對象，因為只有酒店可以處理。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The coach blamed the goalkeeper for the defeat, but the goalkeeper did not play in the match.

questions.answer: The coach barked up the wrong tree by blaming the goalkeeper for the defeat because he did not play in the match.
questions.answerZh: 教練怪錯了守門員，因為他根本沒有在該場比賽上場。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: I searched the office for my phone, but I had left it at home.
questions.promptZh: 我在辦公室尋找手機，但原來把它留在家中。
questions.answer: I was barking up the wrong tree by searching the office for my phone; I had left it at home.
questions.answerZh: 我在辦公室尋找手機是找錯地方；我原來把它留在家中。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: They blamed the rain for the café being closed. In fact, the owner had closed it to repair the kitchen.
questions.promptZh: 他們以為咖啡店因下雨而關門。事實上，店主是為了維修廚房而關店。
questions.answer: They were barking up the wrong tree when they blamed the rain; the owner had closed the café to repair the kitchen.
questions.answerZh: 他們把咖啡店關門怪在下雨上是找錯原因；店主其實是關店維修廚房。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The customer is complaining to the cashier about a late online order, but the delivery team handles it.
questions.promptZh: 顧客正向收銀員投訴網上訂單遲到，但這件事由送貨組處理。
questions.answer: The customer is barking up the wrong tree by complaining to the cashier about the late online order; the delivery team handles it.
questions.answerZh: 顧客向收銀員投訴網上訂單遲到是找錯對象；送貨組才負責處理。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: Dad thinks the music comes from my room, but it comes from the flat upstairs.

questions.answer: Dad is barking up the wrong tree if he thinks the music comes from my room; it comes from the flat upstairs.
questions.answerZh: 如果爸爸認為音樂來自我的房間，他便找錯方向；聲音其實來自樓上的單位。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.promptZh: 我們不停更換插頭來修理燈，但真正壞掉的是燈泡。
questions.answer: We were barking up the wrong tree by changing the plug; the broken bulb was the real problem.
questions.answerZh: 我們更換插頭是用錯方法；真正的問題是燈泡壞了。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The police questioned Aaron about the theft, but the camera showed that he was in another shop.
questions.promptZh: 警方因盜竊案盤問亞倫，但閉路電視顯示他當時在另一間商店。
questions.answer: The police were barking up the wrong tree by questioning Aaron about the theft; the camera showed that he was in another shop.
questions.answerZh: 警方就盜竊案盤問亞倫是追查錯方向；閉路電視顯示他當時在另一間商店。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: Whenever sales fall, the manager blames the weather. However, customers say the prices are too high.
questions.promptZh: 每當銷量下降，經理都會歸咎天氣。然而，顧客表示價格太高。
questions.answer: The manager always barks up the wrong tree when she blames the weather for low sales; customers say the prices are too high.
questions.answerZh: 經理每次把銷量低迷歸咎天氣，都是找錯原因；顧客表示價格太高。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The team has spent two weeks checking the computer, but the broken cable is the problem.
questions.promptZh: 團隊花了兩星期檢查電腦，但問題其實是電線損壞。
questions.answer: The team has been barking up the wrong tree for two weeks by checking the computer; the broken cable is the problem.
questions.answerZh: 團隊兩星期來一直檢查電腦，方向錯了；真正的問題是電線損壞。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: Only the airline can change your flight, so asking me will not help.
questions.promptZh: 只有航空公司可以更改你的航班，所以請我處理並沒有幫助。
questions.answer: If you ask me to change your flight, you will be barking up the wrong tree because only the airline can do it.
questions.answerZh: 如果你請我更改航班，你便找錯人，因為只有航空公司可以處理。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: Perhaps the app is not making the phone slow. The phone’s storage is full.
questions.promptZh: 應用程式可能不是令手機變慢的原因。手機的儲存空間已滿。
questions.answer: We may be barking up the wrong tree by blaming the app for the slow phone; its storage is full.
questions.answerZh: 我們可能怪錯了應用程式；手機變慢可能是因為儲存空間已滿。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The class is searching the classroom for the missing box, but it was moved to the store room yesterday.
questions.promptZh: 全班正在課室尋找失蹤的箱子，但箱子昨天已被移到儲物室。
questions.answer: Could the class be barking up the wrong tree by searching the classroom, since the box was moved to the store room yesterday?
questions.answerZh: 箱子昨天已被移到儲物室，因此全班在課室尋找會否是找錯方向？
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: Are we right to blame Sam for the broken window? He left before it happened.
questions.promptZh: 我們把窗戶破裂怪在森姆身上是否正確？事情發生前他已經離開。
questions.answer: Are we barking up the wrong tree by blaming Sam for the broken window, since he left before it happened?
questions.answerZh: 森姆在事情發生前已經離開，因此我們把破窗怪在他身上，是否找錯對象？
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: A: Should I ask Rachel to approve my leave? B: Rachel is not your manager.
questions.promptZh: 甲：我應否請瑞秋批准我的假期？ 乙：瑞秋不是你的經理。
questions.answer: No. You would be barking up the wrong tree by asking Rachel to approve your leave because she is not your manager.
questions.answerZh: 不應該。你請瑞秋批准假期是找錯對象，因為她不是你的經理。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The doctor first thought food caused the stomach pain, but a test showed that a virus caused it.
questions.promptZh: 醫生最初認為食物引致肚痛，但檢查顯示原因是病毒。
questions.answer: The doctor had been barking up the wrong tree by blaming food before the test showed that a virus caused the pain.
questions.answerZh: 醫生在檢查結果出來前把肚痛歸咎食物，其實找錯了原因；結果顯示是病毒所致。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: The school plans to make the lessons longer, but unclear instructions may be the real problem.
questions.promptZh: 學校計劃延長課堂時間，但真正的問題可能是指示不清楚。
questions.answer: The school might be barking up the wrong tree by making the lessons longer; unclear instructions may be the real problem.
questions.answerZh: 學校延長課堂時間可能是用錯方法；真正的問題可能是指示不清楚。
questions.targetMeaning: To direct your blame, suspicion, attention or effort towards the wrong person, cause, place or solution because your original belief is mistaken.

questions.prompt: You are asking me for a refund, but the shop handles payments. I only delivered the parcel.
questions.promptZh: 你正在要求我退款，但付款事宜由商店處理。我只負責送貨。
questions.answer: I’m afraid you’re barking up the wrong tree by asking me for a refund; the shop handles payments, and I only delivered the parcel.
questions.answerZh: 恐怕你要求我退款是找錯對象；付款事宜由商店處理，而我只負責送貨。
